summary: Desktop chat app for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, local Ollama models and more, with your chats stored on your device.

heroCommands.command: Get the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux from GitHub Releases or chatboxai.app

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Chatbox is a desktop client for chatting with ChatGPT, Claude and other LLMs. This repository is the open-source Community Edition, which the team keeps in sync with their pro version.
sixtySeconds.problem: Juggling a different web app for each AI model is clumsy. Chatbox puts many providers, including local models via Ollama, in one desktop app that keeps your data local.
whoFor: People who use several AI models
Users who want a desktop app with local chat history
Ollama users who want a friendly interface
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a polished, no-setup desktop app that works with many providers, with local data storage and a GPLv3 community edition.
requirements: Windows 10 x64, macOS 11+, or Ubuntu 20.04+ / AppImage-capable Linux
An API key for your chosen provider, or Ollama for local models

overview: Download the installer for your platform, install and launch, set up your AI provider (OpenAI, Claude and others) in settings, and start chatting.
Supported providers listed in the README include OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Google Gemini, Ollama and ChatGLM-6B, plus Dall-E-3 image generation. Data stays on your device.
Developers can clone the repo, run pnpm install and pnpm run dev. The Community Edition is GPLv3 licensed.
